Alex bought 24 notebooks.
Ben bought 24 / 4 = 6 notebooks.

Step 2: Find out how many notebooks Alex gave away to his sister.

Alex bought 24 notebooks.

Step 4: Determine the difference between the number of notebooks Alex and Ben have now.
Alex has 12 notebooks and Ben has 6 notebooks.

Alex has 12 - 6 = 6 more notebooks.
